reasoning_traces.think:
Tracking separation overestimates true coverage distance by an order of magnitude because it measures distance to any tracked defender, not just the covering one. This leads to an inversion where completions appear farther away than incompletions, violating the expected negative correlation between separation and completion rate. The failure arises from incorrect set membership: tracked defenders include deep safeties that are irrelevant to the WR-coverage matchup. Consequently, tracking separation cannot be used as a direct proxy for NGS separation in predictive models.
